summary_of_bug: TarUtils.parseOctal accepts malformed tar octal fields instead of rejecting them with IllegalArgumentException. Based on the test and report, the parser is incorrectly handling field boundaries and trailer bytes: it should require a valid tar octal field with a trailing space/NUL, reject too-short buffers, mixed/all-but-not-all NUL fields, non-octal characters, missing trailer, and embedded spaces or NULs.
